summary: Iter 126: Batch-tested SDL-1 (attendance log), FC-2 (family coordinator), SD-3 (Statement of Rights annotations) end-to-end. Backend integration: 20 pass / 1 skipped (no zero-anomaly statement available). SoR unit tests: 7/7 pass. Frontend UI verified for SDL-1 attendance page (filters, actions, reconcile, dispute modal), FC-2 hub (all 5 tabs, task add/complete, distress-note crisis panel, message send, handover-btn present), Round 2 regression (BC-2 sliders, handover-pack form) still work, all page titles are '<Name> | Wayly'. Profile Quick-Actions links (sdl1-attendance-open + fc2-coordinator-open) present. ONE CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: <StatementRightsPanel> only renders in the legacy pre-decoder branch of StatementDetail.jsx, so on any decoded statement (audit_json && extracted_json truthy — which is the norm) the SD-3 rights panel is never mounted.

ui_bugs.issue: The Your rights panel (data-testid statement-rights-panel) is placed inside the ELSE branch of `stmt.audit_json && stmt.extracted_json ? <DecoderResultView/> : <>...panel...</>`. Modern decoded statements go into the decoder branch, so <StatementRightsPanel> is never mounted. On statement 408fcbf3-c126-4897-a9b1-c76628c49ca7 (which has 4 rights on the API) the panel never fires the /api/sd3/.../rights-annotations request and the DOM has no statement-rights-panel node.

integration_issues.issue: Backend endpoint returns correct 4-right payload for the target statement; frontend never renders the panel because it is nested in the legacy view branch. Move <StatementRightsPanel statementId={id}/> outside/after the conditional so it is rendered for both decoder and legacy statements.

issues: Persistent hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — same warning flagged in iter 125. Not blocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend for SDL-1/FC-2/SD-3 all green. The one open item is the StatementRightsPanel placement in /app/frontend/src/pages/StatementDetail.jsx line 407 — it must be moved outside the `stmt.audit_json && stmt.extracted_json` ternary so it renders in both branches. Confirm the fix by opening /app/statements/408fcbf3-c126-4897-a9b1-c76628c49ca7 (should show 4 rights, 2 of which have 'Relevant here'). Then find a zero-anomaly statement (e.g., via /api/statements filter) and confirm the panel shows only the 3 baseline rights (make_a_complaint, advocacy_support — actually 2, since the sor service returns only what was triggered plus baselines; unit test test_empty_statement_returns_baseline_rights already asserts baseline-only). Re-run: pytest backend/tests/test_iter126_sdl1_fc2_sd3.py backend/tests/test_sor_annotations.py.
rca of the issue: RCA: StatementDetail.jsx introduces a conditional at line 333 — `{stmt.audit_json && stmt.extracted_json ? () : (<>...anomaly list + + line-items-table...)}`. The rights panel and line-items-table are both authored inside the ELSE fragment (lines 344-447). Any statement that has been decoded (has both audit_json and extracted_json — the default for all real uploads) takes the IF branch and never renders those siblings. The DOM query for [data-testid=statement-rights-panel] returns null and no /api/sd3/.../rights-annotations request is ever fired. Reproduction: log in as cathy → /app/statements/408fcbf3-c126-4897-a9b1-c76628c49ca7 → observe rendered DecoderResultView (StreamBreakdown visible) but no rights panel; devtools shows no sd3 network call. Mitigation: pull the `` up above the ternary or place it after the closing `` at line 474 (before archive/delete modals) so it renders for both code paths.
